evidence_items.explanation: ARC Prize reports 75.7% and 87.5% on its semi-private evaluation for two compute settings of the tested o3 preview, describing substantial progress in novel-task adaptation. It also documents remaining easy-task failures, so the result neither proves a general solution nor supports an absence of progress.

unresolved_gaps: The retrieved record does not comprehensively assess proposed solutions across all four capabilities and across AI approaches.
No agreed threshold supplied by the claim distinguishes a principled general solution from a substantial partial solution.
Failures in particular tested systems cannot establish the universal negative.
